caption: The drawing consists of two views of a bed frame, rendered in fine pencil lines on a light beige or tan background. The view on the left depicts the side profile of the bed, showing four posts—two at each end—with the posts at the head of the bed noticeably taller than the foot posts. An arched rod connects the tops of the head posts, while a horizontal rail links the foot posts. The head posts feature turned, elongated, and bulbous ornamental sections above squared bases. The view on the right displays the bed from the front, showing the same four posts, all topped with rods extending vertically. The posts are connected by horizontal rails, with the top rail positioned at the same height as the post tops, and another rail partway down, indicating the position for the headboard insert. Measurements are noted in both views: the side view indicates a length of 6 feet 5 inches, and the front view shows a width of 4 feet 8 inches. The overall drawing consists only of outlined forms without any shading, color, or decorative detail inside the frame, and it is oriented precisely with both views aligned in scale, demonstrating the structure and dimensions of the bed.
title: Desk
